title: DIGITAL MARKETING SERVICES
agency_path: City of New York > City University
submit_to: 31-10 Thomson Avenue, Room E-408, Long Island City, NY 11101
description_text:
LaGuardia Community College, CUNY is seeking proposals from qualified digital marketing firms to provide comprehensive marketing and advertising services that will enhance brand awareness, increase engagement with prospective and current students, and support institutional enrollment and outreach objectives. The selected vendor will be expected to develop and implement strategic, data-driven marketing campaigns across digital channels, leveraging industry best practices, audience analytics, and performance metrics to maximize reach and return on investment.

Subcontracting is allowed with College's written approval. Contract Term: Two Years
